description: List work orders. Filter by status (NEW, IN_PROGRESS, ON_HOLD, COMPLETED, CANCELLED), priority (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, URGENT), type (PM, REACTIVE), and site. Amounts are bare numbers with no currency: call get_organization_settings for currency_code before stating one.

page.description: Page number (default: all pages fetched automatically)

per_page.description: Items per page (default: 1000, max: 1000). All pages are fetched automatically.

priority.description: Filter by priority: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, URGENT

status.description: Filter by status: NEW, IN_PROGRESS, ON_HOLD, COMPLETED, CANCELLED

type.description: Filter by type: PM (preventive) or REACTIVE

name: list_work_orders
title: List work orders
